name: JWT Selector Authenticator
author: Miguel Acedo Marfil

sections.description:
This plugin will allow WordPress administrators to select which posts must have JWT authentication to access them, securing their content efficiently and securely.
In addition, the administrator will be able to select the type of algorithm to be used in each of the pages (PRO version), to increase the security of each one depending on its content.

1.3

Initial stable version of the plugin. Make sure you have configured the keys correctly in your wp-config.php.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate it from the WordPress ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Configure the options from the corresponding administration page
sections.faq:
Do I need to configure anything to use JWT? ==
Yes, you will need to define a secret key (or public/private if you use RSA) in plugin settings menu.

Is it compatible with all themes? ==
Yes, as long as you use the standard WordPress functions to render content.

short_description: This add-on allows the administrator to select which publications will only be accessible by providing a JWT per URL.
